captcha.altchaCaptchaDescription: Based on proof-of-work mechanisms, Altcha Captcha employs a fundamentally new approach to securely defend your websites and online services from spam and bots.

helpText.altchaCaptchaInvisible: The captcha is only displayed when it could not be verified automatically. Automatic verification is set to "onsubmit".
helpText.altchaCaptchaChallengeTtl: How long a challenge stays usable. Each challenge is accepted only once; a shorter window bounds the remaining replay gap, a longer one gives visitors more time to fill in the form. Default 300, clamped to 30-3600.
helpText.altchaCaptchaCost: Iterations per hashing attempt. Higher values raise the cost for bots and the time visitors wait for verification. Default 5000, clamped to 1000-200000.
